comment_overrides: Pins rpc-websockets (pulled in by @solana/web3.js) to a build that uses a CommonJS-safe uuid. Newer rpc-websockets pulls an ESM-only uuid that crashes Vercel's Node runtime with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM. 9.3.8 satisfies web3.js's ^9 range and ships a uuid that require() can load.
